svg.aria-label: Which kind of module to write: a technique that carries bytes is a transport, base if it opens the connection and overlay if it wraps one; one that speaks proxy semantics is a proxy protocol; one that recognises a protocol in the first bytes is a sniffer; one that carries DNS messages is a DNS server; one that lets another program read or control the core is an API. Every kind is one folder under module/ and one line in core/registry/default.go.
svg.title: Which kind of module to write
